column1: # Key of the cipher passage of Schönberg's journal, fol. 114r (LATh - StA Altenburg, Schönbergische Sammlung Nr. 107): simple substitution in Latin letters, regular (24-letter alphabet: odd plaintext letters -> z y x w u t s r q p o n, even -> a b c d e f g h i k l m).
# Values seen in the learning lines L1-L5 are in frozen/KEY.tsv (frozen before the measurement); e, h, l, m, o completed afterwards from the pattern (m and o confirmed by 'zu Zeugen', 'geschwohren').
